edition_title: September 2026 Edition: Build Now, Nigeria's Ecosystem Is Wide Open
edition_intro: Ambitious young Nigerians, this month's list rewards people who move fast: a fully funded master's in Beijing, a nine-figure naira startup fund straight from the Federal Ministry of Youth Development, and free certification vouchers that cost you nothing but effort. None of these charge a fee to apply. Read the deadlines carefully, some close in days, and get your applications in.

posts.title: Schwarzman Scholars 2027-2028 Cohort
posts.summary: A fully funded one-year Master's in Global Affairs at Tsinghua University in Beijing, covering tuition, travel, housing, and a stipend.
posts.eligibility: Bachelor's degree holders aged 18 to 28 by 1 August 2027, from any country including Nigeria, applying under the global/US track

posts.title: NiYA Startup Pitch 2.0
posts.summary: A Federal Ministry of Youth Development initiative putting a ₦100 million funding pool behind 100 youth-led Nigerian tech startups, plus mentorship and enterprise tools.
posts.eligibility: Nigerians aged 18 to 35, with at least two co-founders and a registered NiYA community profile

posts.title: Wetech Conference 2026: The Power Shift
posts.summary: Africa's largest gathering for women in tech, bringing 2,500+ founders, investors, and operators together in Lagos to talk AI, capital, and leadership.
posts.eligibility: Open registration; women in tech and allies across the African tech ecosystem

posts.title: GTCO Squad Hackathon 3.0
posts.summary: A national fintech hackathon from GTCO's Squad platform offering up to ₦10 million in cash prizes to student and developer teams.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian university students, developers, and early-stage startup teams
